projects.title: Summer Internship
projects.description: Data analysis and market trends for insurance applications.
projects.summary: Executed web scraping and data cleaning on insurance applications, built an interactive Power BI dashboard, and applied NLP-based topic modeling to deliver a comprehensive analysis of market trends.
key_contributions: Executed web scraping of websites to systematically extract relevant data on various insurance applications, then developed a script for subsequent data cleaning.
Developed and deployed an interactive dashboard using Power BI for advanced data visualization and in-depth analysis.
Utilized NLP-based topic modeling techniques to analyze application descriptions, identifying key topics and themes, thereby delivering a comprehensive analysis of market trends.

projects.title: Summer Internship
projects.description: Real-time environmental monitoring system with Raspberry Pi.
projects.summary: Built a real-time monitoring system gathering temperature, pressure, and humidity values from sensors connected to a Raspberry Pi 4, with instant storage in Firebase and visualization through a mobile application.
key_contributions: Gathered temperature, pressure, and humidity values using DHT11 and BMP280 sensors connected to a Raspberry Pi 4 board.
Implemented instant storage of data in a real-time Firebase database.
Enabled real-time monitoring of the recorded temperature, pressure, and humidity and consulting data evolution in the database, visualized through curves plotted on the mobile application.
